_comment: Curated operator company-type overrides. The source parent/child company_type columns sometimes tag an operator against its real business model. The motivating case: Real Property Management (RPM) is a national property-management FRANCHISE whose offices hold brokerage licenses, so the source tags them "Brokerage" and the pipeline would bucket them as brokers (hidden from ranked lists + PM cohort math). Each entry forces an operator to a fixed operatorType, matched on the normalized display name (normalize_name of the scorecard name), applied in pipeline.py classify step (overriding the source majority-vote). Keyed by name (not company id) because child ids churn across refreshes. Single source of truth for the pipeline.
